data.titulo: Chize ha Utuswilo mu Engitu ndo hali Mwanangana Mutangu wa Izalele
data.contenido:
Mose yasongwela A-Izalele ha kutuhuka mu undungo mu Engitu ndo ku Mulundu wa Sinai, kuzekwene kwe Zambi ehele shimbi jenyi. Kulutwe lia matangwa, Mose yatuma 12 a malunga hanga atale chifuchi cha Kanana. Alioze 10 a kuli ayo yafuna ni lusango mupi. Chino chinakanyongesa atu hanga afune ku Engitu. Ha kuhona ufulielo, Zambi yecha A-Izalele hanga amone lamba ha kweendesa mu unji wa 40 a miaka mu puya.

Mba hi, yasakula Yoshua asongwele A-Izalele hanga anjile mu chifuchi cha Kanana. Yehova yalinga yikomokeso hanga amukwase kutambula chifuchi. Iye yamanyisa meya a Lwiji Yordau, yapuzula yipanga ya Yeriku, nawa yamanyisa mwalwa ha tangwa lieswe lia muwundu. Yikupalika miaka yisambano, mba yijitambula chifuchi kuli A-Kanana.

Kuputukila kuli Yoshua, A-Izalele kanakaayula ha 356 a miaka kuli akwa kuyula. Yetwe mutulilongesa amwe akuli ayo ngwe, Mbarake, Ngideone, Jefeta, Samasone, ni Samuele. Mututanga nawa hakutwala kuli mapwo ngwe Rahape, Debola, Jaele, Rute, Noemi, ni Ndelila. Mu Chihanda CHAMUCHITATU muli yishima yize yinakalinga 396 a miaka.

YENA unanyingika ai yene yika atu anatongwona hashi? Yinasoloka ngwe chiwe. Yili yitoma ngwe mbundu. Mba alioze hi chiwe ko, yili yimwe yuma ya kulia.

Te hi kwapalika kakweji umuwika chize muze A-Izalele atuhukile mu Engitu. Ayo te jili mu puya. Mu puya kulia te chikehe chilimo, kashika atu apwile ni kulisozwola ngwo: ‘Yetwe te tunazange ngwo Yehova atuchahe kwetu mu Engitu. Mu Engitu te yetwe twakupwa ni kulia cheswe chize tunafupu.’

Kashika Yehova yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yami mungunokesa kulia mwilu.’ Chenacho che Yehova anakalinga. Chimene chize chinakasuloho, A-Izalele yamona yuma ai yitoma yinaholoka mwilu, ayo yalihula umwe ni mukwo ngwo: ‘Ai yene yika?’

Mose yamba kuli ayo ngwenyi: ‘Chino chili kulia chize Yehova anwaha hanga nulie.’ Atu yaputula kuchivuluka ngwo MANAA. Te cha kuyekemena ngwe bolu ya uchi.

Mose yalweza atu ngwenyi: ‘Mutu ni mutu ndo atongone nikulita ni chize mahasa kulia.’ Chimene cheswe ayo te che akulinga. Ha kusasaminya cha mwalwa, manaa eswe waze apwile ni kusala hashi te kakusangunuka.

Mose yamba nawa ngwenyi: ‘Niumwe kanda apombesa manaa hanga akalie tangwa likwo.’ Alioze atu akwo yalengulula. Yena unanyikika yize yinakapwa ko? Chimene chize chinakasuloho, manaa waze anakatulika yaawana hapwa ni mavuno anji, nawa te kananuku vumba lipi! Yehova kanakatuma kuli atu ngwo, ha pwoso tangwa limuwika lie te ayo mahasa kukunga manaa anji kaali keswe. Te tangwa liamuchisambano. Nawa Yehova yamba ngwo, ndo te atulike ndambu hanga akalie ha tangwa lize mulizoho, mumu iye te kechi kunokesa nichimwe ha tangwa liamuchishimbiali. Muze ayo te akutulika manaa hanga akalie ha tangwa liamuchishimbiali, te keshi kupwa ni mavuno nawa te keshi kunuka vumba lipi! Chino te chikomokeso chikwo!

Miaka yeswe yize A-Izalele anakalinga mu puya Yehova te kakwalisa manaa.Kutuhuka 16:1-36; Kwalula 11:7-9; Yoshua 5:10-12. Yihula ya Longeso

TE HI kwapalika tukweji aali chize muze atuhukile mu Engitu, A-Izalele yaheta ku Mulundu wa Sinai, te kakuuvuluka nawa ngwo Horepe. Ha chihela chinochene he Yehova ahanjikile ni Mose ku chiputa cha mulengi wa kahia. Atu kanakalingoho matangwa anji.

Muze atu te anashimbwila, Mose yanyina ku mulundu. Kwenako, Yehova mba yahanjika ni Mose ngwo Iye kanazange hanga A-Izalele ononokene kuli Iye nawa apwe atu Jenyi apema. Muze Mose yasunuka, iye yalumbununa kuli A-Izalele yuma yeswe yize Yehova ambile. Nawa atu yamba ngwo mutwononokena kuli Yehova, mumu ayo te kanazange kupwa atu jenyi.

Mba Yehova yalinga chimwe chuma. Iye yatuhwisa mwishi helu lia mulundu, ni kukulunguza. Iye yamba nawa kuli atu ngwenyi: ‘Yami nguli Yehova, Zambi yenu yoze unakanutuhwisa mu Engitu.’ Kashika iye yaaha shimbi ngwo: ‘Kanda nuwayila niumwe zambi mukwo ndo yami wika.’

Zambi yahana nawa kuli A-Izalele shimbi jikwo livwa. Atu yevwa woma unji. Ayo yahanjika ni Mose ngwo: ‘Yena hanjika ni yetwe, mumu yetwe tuli ni woma wa Zambi nyi mahanjika ni yetwe mutufwa.’

Kulutwe lia yino yuma, Yehova yahanjika ni Mose ngwenyi: ‘Tweya kuli yami kuno ku mulundu. Yami mungukwaha yihanda yaali ya mawe, waze hingunasoneka shimbi jize yami ngunazange hanga atu ajikaule.’ Muze Mose akandukile ku mulundu. Yalinga ko 40 a matangwa ni ufuku.

Zambi kanakapwa ni shimbi jinji hanga te ahane kuli atu jenyi. Mose yasoneka shimbi jacho. Zambi yahana nawa kuli Mose yihanda yaali ya mawe. Zambi, iye mwene te hasonekoho kulu 10 lia shimbi hanga te ajilweze kuli atu eswe. Kakujivuluka ngwo Kumi lia Shimbi.

Kumi lia Shimbi jeswe jino jili ni ulemu unji. Mba alioze Zambi yahana shimbi jikwo jinji kuli A-Izalele. Shimbi jacho muli yimwe yize yinambe ngwo: ‘Ukazange Yehova Zambi ye ni mbunge ye yeswe, ni mwono we weswe, ni kunyonga che cheswe.’ Shimbi yikwo yinambe ngwo: ‘Ukazange mwenyembo we ngwe chize wakulizanga yena mwene.’ Mwana wa Zambi, Yesu Kristu, kanakamba ngwo Yehova kanakahana shimbi jino jinene jaali kuli Izalele. Kulutwe, mba mutukalilongesa chinji hakutwala kuli mwana wa Zambi ni malongeso jenyi.Kutuhuka 19:1-25; 20:1-21; 24:12-18; 31:18; Shimbi Yamuchiali 6:4-6; Ulevi 19:18; Mateu 22:36-40. Yihula ya Longeso

TALA KAMA! Yika atu analinga haliapwila? Ayo kanalembe kuli mwana-ngombe! Mumu liaka ayo analinga chuma chino?

Muze Mose te anashimbula chinji ku mulundu, atu yamba ngwo: ‘Yetwe tuso kunyingika yize yapwa kuli Mose. Kashika tulingenu umwe zambi hanga atuchize mu chifuchi chino.’

Arone, ndumbu ya Mose yamba ngwenyi: ‘Chinawaha.’ ‘Zulenu yingeliengelie ya oru, nawa yinehenu kuli yami.’ Muze atu halinga chocho, Arone yayizuzumuna yayilinga mwana-ngombe wa oru. Atu yamba ngwo: ‘Yono mwe Zambi yetu, yoze watutuhwisa mu Engitu!’ Hohene A-Izalele yalinga chiwanyino chinene, nawa yaputuka kuwayila mwana-ngombe wa oru.

Muze Yehova achimwene, iye yevwa uli unji. Kashika iye yamba kuli Mose ngwenyi: ‘Palumuka kawashi. Atu kanalinga upi unji. Ayo havulama shimbi jami nawa kanafulamana kulutwe lia mwana-ngombe wa oru.’ Mose yasunuka kawashi ku mulundu. Nawa muze iye ahetele ha kamwihi, yamona yino. Atu te kanembi hamwe ni kuhangana kulutwe lia mwana-ngombe wa oru! Mose yevwa uli unji iye yaholola yihanda yaali yamawe yize te yili ni shimbi, nawa mawe jacho yapalwoka. Iye yakwata mwana-ngombe wa oru yamwocha mu kahia ni kumufwenya hashi. Hohene yapwa fufuta.

Atu kanakalinga chuma chipi chinji. Kashika Mose yatuma malunga hanga ande tutana two. Mose yamba ngwenyi: ‘Atu eswe api waze te anawayila mwana-ngombe wa oru chatamba kwashaha.’ Mba malunga jacho yashaha 3,000 a atu! Yino yisokusolola ngwo yetwe ndo chatutamba kuwayila wika Yehova, hi tuzambi twa mahuza ko?Kutuhuka 32:1-35. Yihula ya Longeso

YENA unanyingika zuwo lino liaka? Yili yimwe mbalaka yipema ya uwayilo wa Yehova. Kakuyivuluka nawa ngwo tabernakulu. Atu kanakahwisa utungilo wayo muze te hikwapalika mwaka umuwika chize muze atuhukile mu Engitu. Yena unanyingika ni nyonga liaya anakayitunga?

Ni nyonga lia Yehova. Muze te Mose uchili ku mulundu wa Sinai, Yehova yamulweza chize mayitunga. Iye yamba ngwenyi yitunge nawa ndo yipwe yashi ha kuyisokwola. Yihanda yayo te mahasa kuyimbata ku chihela chikwo, ni kuyipachika nawa cheka. Kashika muze A-Izalele anakapwa ni kututulwoka mu chihela cheka ni cheka mu puya, ayo te kakumbata mbalaka yacho.

Nyi yena watala mukachi lia chipatulo chikehe kusongo lia mbalaka, muhasa kumona umwe mushete hanji kasha. Uno te kakuuvuluka ngwo mushete wa usendo. Helu lia mushete hali angelo aali hanji akerupimi akulinga ni oru, kali kumasongo eswe ni aali a mushete. Zambi yasoneka nawa Kumi lia Shimbi ha yihanda yaali ya mawe, mumu Mose te hanapalula atangu. Mawe jacho te kakwatulika muchima lia mushete wa usendo. Nawa mwapwile umwe musenge wa manaa. Yena uneuluka manaa yika?

Ndumbu ya Mose Arone yamusakula kuli Yehova hanga apwe sasendote wa lutwe. Iye te kakusongwela atu mu uwayilo wa Yehova. Ana jenyi noo te asasendote.

Haliapwila tala mu chipatulo chinene cha mbalaka. Chili chinene kaali keswe kuhianyisa kachipatulo kakehe. Yena unamona umwe mushete ukehe muze munatuhuka kamwishi? Chino che chilumbilo haze asasendote te akwochela chuma cha vumba lipema chize anavuluka ngwo insensu. Muli nawa chikwachilo cha ndeya chize chili ni temo shimbiali. Nawa chuma chamuchitatu chili mukachi ka chipatulo meza. Helu lia meza hali mbolo 12. Muchipanga cha tabernakulu mwapwile yimwe mbashila yinene, te kakuyizalisa ni meya. Asasendote e te akusana meya jacho. Mwapwile nawa chilumbilo chinene. He te akwochela yimuna yize te ayo akushaha ngwe mulambu kuli Yehova. Mbalaka yacho te yatwama mukachi lia chilombo, cha A-Izalele.Kutuhuka 25:8-40; 26:1-37; 27:1-8; 28:1; 30:1-10, 17-21; 34:1, 2; A-Hepreu 9:1-5. Yihula ya Longeso

TALA mihuko anambata kuli malunga wano. Tala kama utohwe wa chisunge achi cha uva. Ndo malunga aali, mba mahasa kuchimbata ku mutondo. Tala nawa makuyu ni romana. Kulihi kunakatuka mihuko yipema chize? Yinakatuka mu chifuchi cha Kanana. Euluka ngwo mu Kanana mwe te atunga Apalahama, Izake, ni Yakomba. Alioze ha mukunda wa zala yize yinakapwamo, Yakomba ni asoko jenyi, yaya ni kutunga mu Engitu. Kashika hakupalika cha miaka 216, Mose yasongwela A-Izalele hanga afune mu chifuchi cha Kanana. Ayo yaheta ha chimwe chihela mu puya chize anavuluka ngwo Kandeshe.

Atu a mu chifuchi cha Kanana te kakwete mbunge jipi. Kashika Mose yatuma ko ngendeshi 12, nawa yaalweza ngwenyi: ‘Fupenu kunyingika atu angahi atungamo, nawa tachi jika ayo akwete. Fupenu kunyingika nyi mavu jamo kali apema, nawa nyi kakukolesa mbuto. Nawa nunehako yimwe mihuko.’

Muze ngendeshi anakafuna ku Kandeshe, ayo yalweza Mose ngwo: ‘Chamwenemwene chili chimwe chifuchi chipema.’ Ha kusolola umwenemwene wacho, ayo yaneha yimwe mihuko hanga alweze Mose. Alioze 10 lia ngendeshi yijamba ngwo: ‘Atu waze atungamo kali anene-anene nawa tachi jinji akwete. Yetwe makatushaha nyi tweseka kutambula chifuchi.’

A-Izalele yevwa woma ha kwivwa maliji wano. Ayo yamba ngwo: ‘Te chipema tufwile kwetu mu Engitu hanji mu puya. Yetwe mutukafwila ku jita, mapwo jetu ni ana jetu makaakwata. Tusakulenu kasongwelo mwaha ha chihela cha Mose, hanga tufune mu Engitu!’

Alioze ngendeshi aali yajikijila kuli Yehova, nawa yeseka kuhumikiza atu. Ayo majina jo te Yoshua ni Kalemba. Ayo yamba ngwo: ‘Kanda nwivwa woma. Yehova kali hamwe ni yetwe. Muchikapwa chashi kutambula chifuchi chacho.’ Alioze atu te kasokutayiza. Ayo yazanga kushaha Yoshua ni Kalemba.

Yehova yevwa uli unji, nawa iye yamba kuli Mose ngwenyi: ‘Atu eswe waze ali ni miaka 20 hanji kuhianisa kechi kanjila mu chifuchi cha Kanana. Ayo kanakamona yikomokeso yize yami ngunakalinga mu Engitu ni mu puya, alioze ayo nihindu kaso kujikijila kuli yami. Kashika ayo malijingajinga mu puya ha 40 a miaka, ndo ha kufwa cho. Yoshua ni Kalemba wika e makanjila mu chifuchi cha Kanana.’Kwalula 13:1-33; 14:1-38. Yihula ya Longeso

TALA yitemo ni amendoa yinachila ku mukombo au, hanji mutango. Uno uli mukombo wa Arone. Yitemo ni mihuko yino yinachila yasokanga ku mukombo wa Arone ha ufuku umuwika! Tutalenu mumu liaka.

A-Izalele te henda mu puya amwe matangwa anji. Atu akwo te haputuka kunyonga ngwo Mose katambile kupwa kasongwelo wo, nawa ni Arone neye te katelele kupwa sasendote wa lutwe. Kora te kali umwe wa kuli waze anyongene chocho, nawa ni Ndatane, Apirame hamwe ni 250 a tusongwelo ja atu. Ayo eswe yaya kuli Mose nawa yamba ngwo: ‘Mumu liaka yena unalisa helu lia yetwe eswe?’

Mose yamba kuli Kora ni kuli tumbaji twenyi ngwenyi: ‘Hamene chimene, munwanda yikwachilo ya kahia munusamo insensu. Mba nukeze ku tabernakulu ya Yehova. Mutukatala iya yoze Yehova makasakula.’

Tangwa lize linakasulaho, Kora ni tumbaji twenyi 250 yeza ku tabernakulu. Nawa kunakeza atu akwo anji hanga akwase malunga jacho. Yehova yevwa uli unji. Mose yamba ngwenyi: ‘Sosolokenu ku mambalaka ja malunga wano api. Kanda nukwata ni chimwe cha kuli ayo.’ Atu yevwako, nawa yasosoloka ku mbalaka ya Kora, Ndatane ni ya Apirame.

Hohene Mose yamba ngwenyi: ‘Mba yenu mununyingika yiya yoze Yehova hanasakula. Hashi muhapulika nawa muhamina malunga wano api.’

Muze Mose hamanyisa kuhanjika, hashi yihapulika. Mbalaka ya Kora ni yuma yenyi yeswe ni ya Ndatane ni Apirame ni waze eswe apwile no yanjila mwishi lia mavu, mba ayo eswe yaashikila mu mavu. Muze atu evwile miteto ya waze te ananjila mu mavu, ayo yamba ngwo: ‘Tuchinenu! Hanga hashi hachine kutumina ni yetwe!’

Kora ni tumbaji twenyi 250 te achili hakamwihi ni tabernakulu. Kashika Yehova yatuma kahia, hohene ayo eswe yawema. Hohene Yehova yamba kuli mwana wa Arone, Eleazare hanga ande yikwachilo ya kahia ya atu waze afwa, hanga ayitungile chilumbilo. Chilumbilo chino te chakukalakala ngwe utowezo kuli A-Izalele, kashika Arone ni anenyi ayo e te makalakala ngwe asasendote a Yehova.

Mba Yehova te kanazange kuhana ushindakenyo ngwo Arone ni anenyi e iye anakasakula hanga apwe asasendote. Nawa iye yamba kuli Mose ngwenyi: ‘Hanjika ni tusongwelo eswe a minyachi ya Izalele hanga eze ni mikombo yo. Ku munyachi wa Levi, Arone ni iye anehe mukombo wenyi. Munusa mikombo yeswe mu tabernakulu kulutwe lia mushete wa usendo. Mukombo wa lunga yoze Yami hingunasakula ngwe sasendote kumuusoka yitemo.’

Chimene chize chinakasuloho, muze Mose ayile ni kuyitala, yawana mukombo wa Arone kuli yitemo ni amendoa jachila kulu! Haliapwila yena muhasa kunyingika mumu liaka Yehova anakasokesa yitemo ku mukombo wa Arone?Kwalula 16:1-49; 17:1-11; 26:10. Yihula ya Longeso

TE hikwapalika miaka ni miaka—10 lia miaka, 20 a miaka, 30 a miaka, 39 a miaka! Nihindu A-Izalele te achili mu puya. Alioze, miaka yeswe ai Yehova yafunga atu jenyi. Iye yaalisa ni manaa. Iye ha mwalwa yaasongwela ni lelwa ha ufuku ni mulenge wa kahia. Ha miaka yeswe ai mazalo jo kakasuwikile chipwe molu jo kakajimbile.

Mba yikuheta kakweji mutangu wa 40 a miaka chize muze akatukile mu Engitu. A-Izalele yatwama nawa cheka ku Kandeshe. Hano he te apwile muze atumine 12 a ngendeshi ku chifuchi cha Kanana, muze te kanda achilinga 40 a miaka. Miriame ndumbu ya Mose wa pwo kanakafwila muzemwene mu Kandeshe. Chizechene ngwe ku mashimbu akunyima, hazehene yapwa ni kapalia.

Atu te kaso kuhasa kuwana meya. Kashika ayo yaputuka kulinyenyeta kuli Mose ngwo: ‘Mala kachi te muhapwa nyi tunakafwa. Mumu liaka unakatuchiza ku Engitu, hanga utunehe kuma kuno kushi kusoka mihuko? Kushi mbuto, kushi makuyu, kushi uva, kushi romana. Kushi meya akunwa.’

Muze Mose ni Arone haya ku tabernakulu hanga alembe, Yehova yamba kuli Mose ngwenyi: ‘Kungulula atu eswe hamuwika. Hanjika ku liwe ali lili kulutwe lia ayo eswe. Mukutuhuka meya anji hanga atu eswe ni yimuna yo anwe.’

Hi Mose yakungulula atu eswe, mba yamba ngwenyi: ‘Panjikenu yenwe kunushi kujikijila kuli Zambi! Shina Arone ni yami mutunutuhwishila meya ku lino liwe nyi?’ Hohene Mose yalamba mukombo wenyi kaali keswe ku liwe liacho, mba yikutuhuka muhuji wa meya anji. Kapwile meya anji akunwa waze te makumbana kuli atu ni yimuna.

Alioze, Yehova yevwila Mose ni Arone uli unji. Yena unanyingika mumu liaka? Mumu Mose ni Arone kanakamba ngwo ayo e matuhwisa meya ku liwe. Kumana, Yehova mwe unakatuhwisa meya jacho. Ha kuhona kuhanjika umwenemwene hakutwala ku yuma yino, Yehova yamba ngwo maamwesa lamba. Yehova yaamba nawa ngwo ‘Yenwe kunuchi kusongwela nawa atu jami mu chifuchi cha Kanana.

Kulutwe lia matangwa A-Izalele yahichika Kandeshe. Hakupalika cha matangwa, ayo yaheta ku mulundu wa Shinare. Hohene kusongo lia mulundu, Arone yafwa. Iye kapwile ni 123 a miaka muze afwile. A-Izalele yapwa ni yinyengo yinji nawa yalila Arone ha 30 a matangwa. Mwanenyi Eleazare, yapwa Sasendote wa lutwe wa vungu lia Izalele.Kwalula 20:1-13, 22-29; Shimbi Yamuchiali 29:5. Yihula ya Longeso

KANASOLOKA ngwe kapela wamwenemwene unasukama ku mutondo nyi ngwami? Ka, hi wamwenemwene ko. Kapela yono kali wakulinga ni unengu. Yehova yatuma Mose hanga amulimbe ku mutondo, hanga atu te ahase kumutala mba atwame ni mwono. Alioze tupela akwo ali hashi kali amwenemwene. Tupela jacho kanasuma atu ni kwayijisa. Yena unanyingika mumu liaka?

Mumu A-Izalele kanakahanjika ni kulimika ni Zambi ni kuli Mose. Ayo yaputuka kulinyenyeta ngwo: ‘Mumu liaka unakatuchiza mu Engitu hanga tufwile muno mu puya? Kuno kushi kulia chipwe meya akwihi. Tuchi kuhasa kulia nawa manaa mumu hatukenya.’

Alioze manaa te kulia chipema. Yehova kanakalinga chikomokeso hanga ehe manaa. Yehova kanakalinga nawa chikomokeso hanga ehe nawa meya. Alioze atu te keshi kusakwilila kuli Zambi ha chize iye te akwafunga. Kashika Yehova yatuma tupela hanga asume A-Izalele. Tupela yasuma atu, anji a kuli ayo yafwa.

Mba hi atu yeza kuli Mose ni kwamba ngwo: ‘Yetwe twavulumuna, mumu twahanjika ni kulimika ni Yehova ni kuli yena. Haliapwila tulembele kuli Yehova hanga achize tupela wano. Chocho Mose yalemba ha kutwala kuli atu jacho. Mba Yehova yatuma Mose hanga alinge kapela yono wa unengu. Yehova yamulweza ngwo amulimbe ku mutondo, hanga amutale kuli mweswao yoze te mamusuma kuli kapela. Mose yalinga nikulita ni chize Zambi amutumine. Kashika, atu waze te maasuma kuli kapela, muze ayo matala kuli kapela wa unengu mba mahinduka.

Lino lili limwe longeso kuli yetwe. Yetwe eswe, tuli ngwe A-Izalele waze anakasuma kuli tupela. Mumu yetwe eswe mwono wetu uli wa mashimbu akehe. Tala sali ni sali, mumona atu chize anapu tushinakaji, anayiza nawa kanafu. Ayino yeswe yinasoloka mumu lunga ni pwo mutangu, mwe Alama ni Eva, kanakehuka kuli Yehova, kashika ni yetwe eswe tunamono lamba, mumu tuli ana jo. Alioze Yehova hanalinga chimwe chuma hanga yetwe tuhase kupwa ni mwono wa miaka yeswe.

Yehova yatuma Mwanenyi, Yesu Kristu, hano hashi. Yesu kanakamuzeleka ha mutondo, mumu atu anji te akunyonga ngwo iye mutu mupi. Alioze Yehova kanakatuma Yesu hanga atulamwine. Nyi yetwe twatala kuli iye, ni kumukaula mutuhasa kupwa ni mwono wa mutolo. Alioze mutukalilongesa hakutwala ku yuma yino yeswe kulutwe.Kwalula 21:4-9; Yoano 3:14, 15. Yihula ya Longeso

YENA hiunevu kama umwe chimbulu kanahanjika? Kota yena muhasa kwamba ngwo, ‘Ka.’ Mumu tushitu keshi kuhanjika.’ Alioze Mbimbiliya yinatulweze ngwo umwe chimbulu kanakahanjika. Tutalenu chize chino chinakapwa.

A-Izalele te kananjila mu chifuchi cha Kanana. Mbalake, mwanangana wa Moape, yevwa woma wa A-Izalele. Kashika iye yasanyika umwe lunga wa kanyama jina lienyi te Mbalau hanga ashinge A-Izalele. Mbalake yalakenya kuhana mbongo jinji kuli Mbalau, kashika Mbalau yakwata chimbulu wenyi yaya hanga aliwane ni Mbalake.

Yehova kakazangile hanga Mbalau ashinge atu jenyi. Chocho iye yatuma umwe mungelo te kali ni njangu yisuku hanga amane mu tapalo akanjise Mbalau. Mbalau kakahashile kumona mungelo wacho, alioze chimbulu wenyi yamumona. Chimbulu yalinga tachi hanga akondoloke mungelo, mba alioze yautama kwenyi hashi mu tapalo. Mbalau yevwa uli unji, hi yaputuka kulamba chimbulu wenyi ni kapama.

Hi Yehova yahanjikisa chimbulu hanga Mbalau amwivwe. Chimbulu yahula ngwenyi, ‘Yika yami nakulinga unangulambila chocho?’

Mbalau yakumbulula ngwenyi, ‘Mumu yena wanguhepwisa. Nyi te nguli ni yimwe njangu kachi nakushaha!’

Chimbulu yahula kuli iye ngwenyi: ‘Yami hingunakulinga kama chuma chino limwe tangwa?’

Mbalau yakumbulula ngwenyi, ‘Ka.’

Hohene Yehova yapangulwisa meso ja Mbalau, mba hi iye yamona mungelo kanamana mu tapalo ni njangu yenyi. Mungelo yamba ngwenyi: ‘Mumu liaka walamba chimbulu we? Yami neza hanga ngukujikinyine mu jila, mumu chakutambile kuya hanga ukashinge Izalele. Nyi kachi chimbulu we kangukondolokele, kachi te nakushahanga kulu, alioze chimbulu we te chichi kumulemeka.’

Mbalau yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yami hinavulumuna. Yami te chiso kunyngika ngwo yena unamana mu tapalo.’ Mungelo yecha Mbalau hanga aye, chocho Mbalau yaya hanga akahanjike ni Mbalake. Chipwe chocho iye kanakeseka kushinga Izalele, alioze Yehova yamushinjila hanga awahise Izalele katatu keswe.Kwalula 21:21-35; 22:1-40; 23:1-30; 24:1-25. Yihula ya Longeso

MOSE yazanga kuya ni A-Izalele mu Kanana. Kashika iye yeta ngwenyi: ‘Yehova, ngweche kama nguzauke Lwiji Yordau, hanga ngutale chifuchi chipema.’ Alioze Yehova yamba ngwenyi: ‘Kwahwa! Kanda wamba nawa yuma yino!’ Yena unanyigika mumu liaka Yehova ambile chocho?

Mumu ha yize yapwile ha mashimbu waze Mose alambile ku liwe. Euluka ngwo, iye ni Arone kakachichimiekene Yehova. Ayo kakambile kuli atu ngwo Yehova mwe waaha meya waze atuhukile ku liwe. Kashika ha mukunda wa yuma yacho Yehova yamba kuli iye ngwo kechi kusongwela nawa a A-Izalele ha kunjila mu Kanana.

Ha kupalika cha amwe tukweji muze Arone te hafwa, Yehova yamba kuli Mose ngwenyi: ‘Kwata Yoshua hanga umuse kulutwe lia Eleazare mwe sasendote ni kumeso ja atu. Kumeso ja mbunga, mwamba kuli eswe ngwo Yoshua mwe kasongwelo mwaha.’ Mose yalinga yeswe yize Zambi amulwezele ngwe chize yena unamono ha chizulie chino.

Mba hi Yehova yamba kuli Yoshua ngwenyi: ‘Pwako ni tachi, kanda wivwa woma. Yena mukasongwela A-Izalele hanga anjile mu chifuchi cha Kanana ngwe chize hingunalakenya, nawa Yami mungukapwa hamwe ni yena.’

Mba hi Yehova yamba kuli Mose hanga anyine helu lia mulundu wa Nebo mu chifuchi cha Moape. Kuzekwene Mose yahasa kumona Lwiji Yordau ni chifuchi chipema cha Kanana. Yehova yamulweza ngwenyi: ‘Chino che chifuchi chize yami ngunakalakenya kuhana kuli ana ja Apalahama, ja Izake ni ja Yakomba. Nakwecha hanga uchitale, alioze uchikunjilamo.’

Mose kanakafwila kuzekwene ku mulundu wa Nebo. Te kali ni 120 a miaka. Iye te uchili ni tachi jinji mu mujimba, nawa meso jenyi te achili angunu. Atu yapwa ni yinyengo yinji nawa yalila ha kufwa cha Mose. Alioze ayo yawahilila hakupwa ni Yoshua ngwe kasongwelo mwaha.Kwalula 27:12-23; Shimbi Yamuchiali 3:23-29; 31:1-8, 14-23; 32:45-52; 34:1-12. Yihula ya Longeso

MALUNGA wano kali mu kapalia. Ayo ndo achine, yika kumashaha. Ayo kali ngendeshi A-Izalele, haliapwila pwo yoze unaakwase kali Rahape. Rahape te katwama ku zuwo lize lili helu lia chipanga cha mbonge ya Yeriku. Tunyingikenu mumu liaka malunga wano ali mu kapalia.

A-Izalele te halilulieka kulu hanga azauke Lwiji Yordau ni kunjila mu Kanana. Muze te chino kanda achichilinga, Yoshua yatuma ngendeshi aali. Iye yamba kuli ayo ngwenyi: ‘Yenu nukatale chize chifuchi chapwa ni mbonge ya Yeriku.’ Muze ngendeshi ahetele mu mbonge ya Yeriku, ayo yaya ku zuwo lia Rahape. Alioze umwe mutu yatoweza mwanangana wa Yeriku ngwenyi: ‘Muno mwanjila A-Izalele aali ha ufuku hanga atale chifuchi.’ Muze mwanangana achivwile, iye yatuma malunga kuli Rahape, hanga amwambe ngwo: ‘Tuhwisa haze malunga waze uli noo mu zuwo!’ Alioze Rahape yasweka ngendeshi jacho helu lia fulumba lia zuwo lienyi. Chocho iye yamba ngwenyi: ‘Ewa, amwe malunga kezanga ku zuwo liami, alioze te chiso kunyingika kwami kuze te ayo anakatuka. Ayo kakatukanga muze te hikwaputuka kutoka, ni chikolo cha mbonge te kanda achi chajila. Nyi nwazomboka, munuhasa kwawana!’ Chocho malunga jacho yaya ni kwafupa.

Muze ayo te haya, Rahape yanyina helu lia fulumba. Yamba kuli ngendeshi ngwenyi: ‘Yami ngunanyingika ngwami Yehova makanwaha chifuchi chino. Yetwe twevwa chize iye omishine meya a mu Kulunga-lwiji Muchila muze nwakatukile mu Engitu, ni chize iye ashahile mianangana a Sahone ni a Oge. Yami nanukwasa chinji, kashika ni yenwe akwetu ngwehenu kama chilakenyo ngwo, munukangukwasa. Hanga nukalamwine tata ni mama, nawa ni mandumbu jami a malunga ni a mapwo.’

Ngendeshi yalakenya kuchilinga, alioze ndo te Rahape alinge chimwe chuma. Ngendeshi yamulweza ngwo, ‘Kwata lwoji au muchila hanga umukase ha kapenda wa zuwo lie, nawa ukakungulula asoko je eswe mu zuwo lie. Muze yetwe eswe mutukafuna hanga tukumbe Yeriku, yetwe mutukamona lwoji yono ha kapenda wa zuwo lie, chocho tuchi kashaha niumwe wa ku zuwo lie.’ Muze ngendeshi afunyine kuli Yoshua yamulumbunwina yuma yeswe yize yapwileko.Yoshua 2:1-24; A-Hepreu 11:31. Yihula ya Longeso

TALA! A-Izalele kanazauka Lwiji Yordau! Mba meya kulihi aya? Mumu ha kangonde wacho te kwakunoka vula munji ha mwaka, ha mashumbu wawene te lwiji kanazala too ni meya. Alioze, haliapwila meya hahuwa! A-Izalele kanazauka ha mavu omu ngwe chizechene azaukile Kalunga-lwiji Muchila! Mba meya eswe kulihi aya? Tutalenu.

Muze te mashimbu haheta kulu hanga A-Izalele azauke Lwiji Yordau, Yehova yamba kuli Yoshua hanga alweze kuli atu ngwo: ‘Asasendote ndo ande mushete wa usendo hanga aye nawo kulutwe lietu. Muze ayo masa molu jo mu Lwiji Yordau, mba meya mamana.’

Chocho asasendote yanda mushete wa usendo, yaya kulutwe lia atu eswe. Muze asasendote hanjila mu Lwiji Yordau, ayo yamana mu meya. Te kunapalika muhuji unene wa meya, nawa lwiji te musuku chinji. Hazehene muze ayo anjishile molu jo mu meya, meya yamana kupalika. Chili chimwe chikomokeso! Yehova kanakateta meya. Hi ha mashimbu akehe mu lwiji mwakapwile nawa meya! Asasendote waze te anambate mushete wa usendo yaya ndo ha mashima ja lwiji muze te meya homa. Yena muhasa kwamona ha chizulie chino? Muze ayo te anamana hazehene, A-Izalele eswe yazauka Lwiji Yordau ha mavu omu! Muze eswe te hazauka kulu, Yehova yatuma Yoshua kulweza kuli 12 a malunga a tachi jinji ngwenyi: ‘Njilenu mu lwiji haze ali asasendote ni mushete wa usendo. Nwande 12 a mawe hanga nwatumbike haze yenwe eswe munukapomba ufuku. Mba kulutwe lia matangwa, muze ana jenu makanuhula ngwo mawe wano yika analumbunuka, nukalweza ngwo, meya kanakamana kupalika muze mushete wa usendo wa Yehova wazaukile mu Yordau. Mawe wano masala ngwe cheulukiso cha chikomokeso chino!’ Yoshua ni neye yasa 12 a mawe ha mashima ja lwiji haze asasendote amanyine.

Mba hi Yoshua yamba kuli asasendote waze te anambata mushete wa usendo ngwenyi: ‘Tutukenu mu Yordau.’ Muze ayo hatutuka, meya yaputuka kupukumuka cheka.Yoshua 3:1-17; 4:1-18. Yihula ya Longeso

MUMU liaka yipanga ya Yeriku yinapuzuka? Yinapu ngwe mbomba akongako. Alioze ha matangwa jacho mbomba te jatwamineko; chipwe mata a kahia te katwamineko. Chino chili chikomokeso chikwo cha Yehova! Tulilongesenu chize yino yinakapwa.

Evwa yize Yehova ambile kuli Yoshua: ‘Yena ni maswalele je munujinga mbonge. Ha tangwa munuyijinga kamuwika ndo ha tangwa liamuchisambano. Munumbata mushete wa usendo hamwe ni yenwe. Asasendote shimbiali ndo maya kulutwe nawa memba yitavwi yo.

‘Ha tangwa lia muchishimbiali yenwe ndo munujinguluka mbonge yisuho shimbiali. Mba munwimba chikolo yitavwi, nawa yenwe eswe munukololoka chikolo ngwe jita. Chocho mba yipanga ya Yeriku muyikapuzuka!’



Yoshua ni atu akwo yalinga yize Yehova anakalweza. Muze ayo te anajinga, eswe yahola kulu. Niumwe kakahanjikile. Eswe yevwa wika kwimba cha yitavwi ni mishindo ya yiliato. Akwa kulimika ni atu ja Zambi mu Yeriku kota kanakevwa woma unji. Yena unamono lungoji auze muchila ha kapenda? Kapenda wacho waya? Ewa, Rahape yalinga chize amulwezele kuli ngendeshi waze aali. Asoko jenyi eswe kanakatwama mu zuwo lienyi ni kutala.

Mba hi ha tangwa lia muchishimbiali, muze hajinguluka mbonge yisuho shimbiali, yemba yitavwi, maswalele yakololoka, mba yipanga yipuzuka. Hohene Yoshua yamba ngwenyi: ‘Shahenu eswe ali mu mbonge nawa yochenu. Ochenu yuma yeswe. Shina wika prata, oru, unengu ni utale, yitulikenu hanga nukayiwezele ha upite mu mbalaka ya Yehova.

Yoshua yamba kuli ngendeshi aali ngwenyi: ‘Yenu ku zuwo lia Rahape, hanga numuchizemo iye hamuwika ni asoko jenyi.’ Rahape ni asoko jenyi yaalamwina, ngwe chize ngendeshi anakamulakenya.Yoshua 6:1-25. Yihula ya Longeso

TALA lunga au yize anavumbika mu mbalaka yenyi! Chimwe chikuto chipema, ni chipinji cha oru nawa ni mbongo ja prata. Iye kayanda mu mbonge ya Yeriku. Mba alioze yika te chatamba kulinga ni yuma ya ku Yeriku? Yena uneuluka?

Yuma yacho kanakayamba ngwo te chatamba kuyonona, alioze oru ni prata te chatamba kuyihana ku upite wa mu tabernakulu ya Yehova. Atu wano kehuka shimbi ya Zambi. Ayo keya yuma yambala ya Zambi. Lunga yono jina lienyi Akane, waze ali noo kali asoko jenyi. Tutalenu yika yinakapwako.

Muze Akane te heya yuma yacho, Yoshua yatuma amwe malunga hanga ase jita ni mbonge ya Ayi. Alioze ayo yaakumba kuli Akwa Ayi. Amwe kanakaashaha, waze anakasaloho ni mwono yachina. Yoshua yevwa yinyengo yinji. Iye yafulamana hashi ni kulemba kuli Yehova ngwenyi: ‘Mumu liaka yena wecha yuma yino yipwe kuli yetwe?’

Yehova yakumbulula ngwenyi: ‘Katuka! Izalele kavulumuna. Ayo kanda yimwe yuma yize te chatamba kuyonona nawa ni yize te chatamba kuyihana ku tabernakulu ya Yehova. Ayo keya chimwe chikuto chipema nawa kachisweka. Yami chichi kunuwahisa nyi kunwonwene yuma yacho, nawa ni atu waze ayiyanga.’ Yehova yamba ngwo makasolwela Yoshua lunga wacho mupi.

Kashika Yoshua yakungulula atu eswe hamuwika, mba Yehova yatongola lunga wacho mupi, mwe Akane. Akane yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yami hinavulumuna. Yami namonanga chimwe chikuto chipema, ni chipinji cha oru hamwe ni mbongo ja prata. Yami yinguyizanga chinji kashika nayandanga. Yenwe munuhasa kuyiwana yakuvumbika mu mbalaka yami.’

Muze awanyine yuma yacho yayitwala kuli Yoshua, iye yamba kuli Akane ngwenyi: ‘Mumu liaka watukokela lamba?’ Haliapwila Yehova makumwesa lamba!’ Hohene atu eswe yaputuka kwasa mawe kuli Akane ni kuli asoko jenyi ndo ha kufwa cho. Chino chinalumbunuka ngwo yetwe chatutambile kwanda yuma yambala, nyi ngwami?

Mba kulutwe lia yino yuma, A-Izalele yaya nawa ni kwasa jita ni Akwa Ayi. Ha chisuho chino Yehova yakwasa atu jenyi, hi A-Izalele yakumba Akwa Ayi.Yoshua 7:1-26; 8:1-29. Yihula ya Longeso

MBONGE jinji ja mu Kanana yijililulieka hanga jase jita ni Izalele. Ayo yanyonga ngwo te mahasa kukumba. Alioze atu waze te atunga mu mbonge ya Ngibeone kakanyongene chocho. Ayo yatayiza ngwo Zambi mwe unakwasa A-Izalele, kashika ayo yalituna kwasa jita ni Zambi. Yena unanyingika yize A-Ngibeone alingile?

Ayo yalionga kupwa ngwe amwe atu waze atwama kusuku chinji. Amwe a kuli malunga jacho yazala mazalo asuwika ni hako jize te hijafwa. Ayo yanda nawa jimwe njeke jikulu ni jimwe mbolo jikulu. Mba ayo yijiya kuli Yoshua, yijamba kuli iye ngwo: ‘Yetwe tunakatuka ku chifuchi chisuku chinji, mumu yetwe hitwevwa hakutwala kuli Zambi yenu munene, mwe Yehova. Yetwe twevwa yuma yeswe yize iye halinga hali yenwe mu Engitu. Kashika miata jetu yatwamba ngwo andenu kulia hanga nulinge wenyi, hanga tunulweze ngwo: “Yetwe tuli ngamba jenu. Tulakenyenu ngwo yenwe nuchi kasa jita ni yetwe.” Yenwe munuhasa kumona mazalo jetu chize afwa ha mukunda wa wenyi, ni mbolo jetu chize hijoma chau nawa chize hi jakwachika mbundu.

Yoshua ni makulwana akwo yatayiza maliji a A-Ngibeone. Chocho ayo yaalakenya ngwo kechi kuliasa noo jita. Mba muze kwapalikile matangwa atatu A-Izalele yanyingika ngwo A-Ngibeone te katwama hakamwihi.

Yoshua yaahula ngwenyi: ‘Mumu liaka nunakatwonga ngwo yenwe ku chifuchi chisuku nunakatuka?’

A-Ngibeone yakumbulula ngwo: ‘Yetwe tunakalinga chocho mumu yetwe tunanyingika ngwo Zambi yenu Yehova hananulakenya kunwaha chifuchi chino cheswe cha Kanana. Kashika yetwe yitwiva woma unji ngwo yenwe te munutushaha.’ Ha chino A-Izalele yalikwachilila ku chilakenyo cho, hi ayo kakashahile A-Ngibeone. Alioze ayo yaatenga ngwe ngamba jo.

Mwanangana wa Yerusaleme yevwa uli unji, ha mukunda wa usendo wa ukulungunga uze A-Ngibeone anakalinga ni Izalele. Kashika iye yamba kuli mianangana akwo awana ngwenyi: ‘Tweyenu hanga nungukwase kwasa jita ni A-Ngibeone.’ Chino che alingile mianangana wano atano. Mianangana wano yeza ni kwasa jita ni A-Ngibeone ha mukunda wa usendo wa ukulungunga uze ayo alingile ni Izalele. Shina A-Ngibeone kanakapwa ni mana ha kulinga usendo wacho? Tutalenu.Yoshua 9:1-27; 10:1-5. Yihula ya Longeso

TALA kuli Yoshua. Iye kanambe ngwenyi: ‘Tangwa, mana ki!’ Ni lie tangwa yilimana lume ki. Yilimana hamuchima ki ha tangwa lieswe lia muwundu. Yehova mwe wachilingile! Mba alioze tutalenu mumu liaka Yoshua te anazange ngwo tangwa limane.

Muze mianangana api atano a mu chifuchi cha Kanana aputukile kwasa jita ni A-Ngibeone, A-Ngibeone yatuma umwe lunga kuli Yoshua hanga ete ukwaso. Iye yamba ngwenyi: ‘Tweya kawashi kuli yetwe! Hanga utulamwine! Mianangana eswe a mu chifuchi heza hanga ase jita ni ngamba je.’

Yoshua yaya lume ni maswalale jenyi eswe. Yenda ufuku weswe. Muze ayo ahetele ku Ngibeone, maswalale ja mianangana atano yevwa woma unji yachina. Mba hi Yehova yanokesa mawe anene-anene hali ayo, mawe jacho kanakashaha maswalale anji, kuhianyisa waze ashahile kuli maswalale ja Yoshua.

Hi Yoshua yamona ngwo tangwa te linayi ni kutoka. Mukupwa ufuku chocho te maswalale ja mianangana api atano mahasa te kuchina. Kashika Yoshua yalemba kuli Yehova ngwenyi: ‘Tangwa, limane ki!’ Muze tangwa liamanyine, mba A-Izalele yahasa kukumba jita yacho.

Alioze te kuli nawa mianangana akwo api anji waze te akwivwila atu ja Zambi kole. Yoshua ni chilombo chenyi kanakalinga unji wa miaka yisambano mba yakumba 31 a mianangana a mu chifuchi chacho. Muze jita yinakahwa, Yoshua yakaula kanawa maliji akutetela chifuchi cha Kanana kuli minyachi ya Izalele.

Kunakapalika miaka yinji, mba Yoshua yafwa ni 110 a miaka. Muze iye ni masepa jenyi te achili ni mwono, atu te kakwononokena kuli Yehova. Alioze muze malunga wano apema afwile, atu yaputuka kulinga yuma yipi ni kulinjisa mu kapalia. Ha mashimbu jacho ayo te kakufupa ukwaso wa Zambi.Yoshua 10:6-15; 12:7-24; 14:1-5; Akwa Kuyula 2:8-13. Yihula ya Longeso

MUZE te A-Izalele akupwa mu kapalia, ayo te kakukololoka kuli Yehova. Yehova te kakwakumbulula ha kwaaha tusongwelo a hamu hanga aakwase. Mu Mbimbiliya kanaavuluka ngwo akwa kuyula. Mukwa kuyula mutangu te Yoshua, kulutwe lienyi yikwiza nawa akwo, majina jo te Oteniele, Ehude ni Shamgare. Alioze atu aali waze anakakwasa nawa Izalele, kali amwe mapwo waze anavuluka ngwo Debola ni Jaele. Debola te profeta wa pwo. Yehova te kakumwaha maliji hakutwala ku yuma yize te muyiza kulutwe lia matangwa, nawa iye te kakwalweza kuli atu ngwo, yino ye Yehova amba. Debola kapwile nawa umwe mukwa kuyula. Iye te kakutwama mwishi lia yimwe yingaji ku milundu ya mu chifuchi, nawa atu te kakwiza kuli iye hanga a ehe ukwaso ku milonga yo.

Ha mashimbu jacho Jabini te mwanangana wa Kanana. Iye kapwile ni 900 a mashinyi a jita. Maswalele jenyi te kakwete tachi jinji, kashika A-Izalele anji anakaashinjila hanga apwe ngamba ja Jabini. Kapitau wa maswalele ja Jabini jina lienyi te Sisera.

Limwe tangwa, Debola yasanyika mukwa kuyula Mbarake, yamba kuli iye ngwenyi: ‘Yehova kanakwambe ngwo: “Yako hanga ukakungulule 10,000 a malunga ku mulundu wa Tabore. Yami mungukaneha Sisera kuli yena. Nawa Yami mungukakwaha kukumba hali iye ni hali maswalele jenyi.”’

Mbarake yamba kuli Debola ngwenyi: ‘Yami munguya nyi yena muoya hamwe ni yami.’ Debola yaya chimuwika ni iye, hohene iye yalweza Mbarake ngwenyi: ‘Yena uchi katambula lufuma wa kukumba, mumu Yehova makahana Sisera ku kwoko lia umwe pwo.’ Yino ye yapwile ko.

Mbarake yapalumuka ku mulundu wa Tabore hanga alitakane ni maswalele a Sisera. Hohene Yehova yatuhwisa umwe muhuji wa meya, hi maswalele anji ja Sisera yatoka mu meya. Alioze Sisera yasunuka mu mashinyi jenyi yachina.

Kulutwe lia amwe mashimbu Sisera yaheta ku mbalaka ya Jaele. Iye yamusanyika hanga anjile mu mbalaka, nawa yamwaha yamwa hanga anwe. Yino yinakamwaha tulo, mba iye yapomba. Hohene Jaele yanda lumbambo wa mbalaka yamuhata mu mutwe wa lunga yono mupi. Muze Mbarake ahetele, Jaele yamusolwela Sisera te hafwa kulu! Nyingika ngwo maliji waze Debola ahanjikile kali amwenemwene.

Hi kusongo, Mwanangana Jabini ni neye yamushaha, mba A-Izalele yapwa ni sambukila ha amwe mashimbu.Akwa Kuyula 2:14-22; 4:1-24; 5:1-31. Yihula ya Longeso

MU Mbimbiliya muli umwe mukanda anavuluka ngwo Rute. Chino chili chimwe chishima cha amwe asoko waze te atwama ha mashimbu waze A-Izalele te achili ni akwa kuyula. Rute te umwe mwana pwo wa ku chifuchi cha Moape; iye te hi wa ku vungu lia Zambi ko, Izalele. Alioze, muze Rute anyingikine hakutwala kuli Zambi wamwenemwene Yehova, iye yaputuka kupwa ni zango linji hali Yehova. Noemi te umwe pwo kashinakaji, iye mwe wakwashile Rute hanga anyingike Yehova.

Noemi te umwe pwo Ka-Izalele. Iye ni mukwo-lunga, ni ana jenyi aali yaya ni kutunga ku chifuchi cha Moape, mumu mu Izalele te kulia chikehe chilimo. Kulutwe lia matangwa lunga lia Noemi yafwa. Hi mba ana ja Noemi yambata ana-mapwo aali A-Moape, majina jo te Rute ni Orpa. Alioze, muze te hikwapalika 10 lia miaka, ana a malunga aali ja Noemi yafwa. Noemi ni ana-mapwo aali yanyenganyana chinji! Yika mba te Noemi malinga?

Limwe tangwa Noemi yanyonga kuhiluka kuli atu jenyi. Rute ni Orpa te kanazange kutwama nenyi hamuwika, kashika ni ayo yamukaula. Alioze muze te haheta ndambu kusuku mu tapalo, Noemi yamba kuli atembwa-anenyi ngwenyi: ‘Hilukenu ku mazuwo ja anoko.’

Chocho, Noemi yahana mbeju kuli atembwa-anenyi hanga alishike no. Ayo yaputuka kulila, mumu te ayo kakuzanga chinji Noemi. Ayo yamba ngwo: ‘Hi chocho ko! Mutuya ni yena kuli atu je.’ Alioze Noemi yaakumbulula ngwenyi: ‘Yenwe ndo nuhiluke, ana jami. Muchipwa chipema nyi nwahiluka ku zuwo.’ Mba hi Orpa yafuna ku zuwo. Alioze Rute kakafunyine.

Noemi yatala kuli iye yamba ngwenyi: ‘Orpa hafuna. Ni yena funa kwe.’ Alioze Rute yamukumbulula ngwenyi: ‘Kanda ungushinjila hanga ngukuhichike! Ngweche nguye ni yena! Kweswako yena muoya, ni Yami munguya, nawa kweswako yena mutwama ni Yami mungutwama. Atu je kumakapwa atu jami, nawa Zambi ye kumakapwa Zambi yami. Kweswako yena mukafwila, ni yami kokwene kwe mungukafwila, akangufunde kokwene.’ Muze Rute hamba chocho, hi Noemi yecha kumushinjila hanga afune ku zuwo.

Mba hi mapwo wano aali yaaheta ku Izalele. Ayo yatunga kuzekwene. Rute yaputuka kukalakala mu minda, mumu te ha mashimbu akuhela sevada. Umwe lunga jina lienyi Mboaze yecha Rute hanga ahele sevada mu minda yenyi. Yena unanyingika naye ya Mboaze te iye? Te Rahape, wa mu mbonge ya Yeriku.

Limwe tangwa Mboaze yamba kuli Rute ngwenyi: ‘Yami hinevwa yuma yeswe hakutwala kuli yena, ni umbovu uze yena ulinawo hali Noemi. Yami ngunanyingika chize yena wahichika tatenu ni noko, ni chifuchi che, hanga wize utwame ni atu waze te kanda uchinyingika. Yehova awahilile hali yena!’

Rute yakumbulula ngwenyi: ‘Mwata yena uli ni umbovu unji kuli yami. Yena wangwaha chiseke chinji hakuhanjika ni yami.’ Mboaze yazanga chinji Rute, nawa yikupalika mashimbu akehe ayo yalimbata. Chino chinakaneha chiseke chinji kuli Noemi! Nawa Noemi kanakawahilila chinji muze Rute ni Mboaze anakasema mwana mutangu, yamuluka jina ngwo Opete. Hi kulutwe lia matangwa, Opete yapwa kako ya Ndawichi, mutukalilongesa chinji kulutwe hakutwala kuli Ndawichi.Mukanda wa mu Mbimbiliya wa Rute. Yihula ya Longeso

YENA unamono yize analinga aha? Wano eswe kali tujita a Izalele. Malunga jacho kanahetama hanga anwe meya. Lunga unamana hakamwihi ni ayo jina lienyi Ngideone mukwa kuyula. Iye kanaatala chize ayo ananu meya.

Tala kanawa kunwa cha malunga awa chinalisa. Amwe kanachikula mitwe yo ndo ha meya. Alioze umuwika kanaswita meya ni kwoko lienyi hanga ahase kutala yize muyipwa kuli iye. Chino te chili ni ulemu, mumu Yehova te hanambe kuli Ngideone ngwo, ndo usakule wika malunga waze anatalatala ha kunwa meya. Zambi yamba ngwenyi, akwo eswe, ndo wahilwise ku zuwo. Tutalenu mumu liaka.

A-Izalele te hapwa nawa mu kapalia. Mumu ayo te kaso kwononokena kuli Yehova. Atu a ku Mindiane yaputuka kwayula ni kwamwesa lamba. Kashika A-Izalele yaputuka kukololoka kuli Yehova hanga akwase, mba Yehova yevwa kukololoka cho.

Yehova yatuma Ngideone hanga akunge yimwe mbunga ya maswalale, mba Ngideone yakunga 32,000 a tujita. Alioze, te kuli mbunga ya maswalale 135,000 a malunga hanga aliase ni Izalele. Mba alioze, Yehova yamba kuli Ngideone ngwenyi: ‘Malunga uli noo oka naye.’ Mumu liaka Yehova anakamba chocho?

Mumu te nyi Izalele makumba jita yacho, ayo te manyonga ngwo kayikumba ku tachi jo. Ayo te mahasa kunyonga ngwo chipwe Yehova katukwashile yetwe ene mutuyikumba. Kashika Yehova yamba kuli Ngideone ngwenyi: ‘Ambila malunga waze eswe anevu woma hanga ahiluke kwo ku zuwo. Muze Ngideone halinga chocho, 22,000 a tujita yahiluka ku zuwo. Iye yasala wika ni 10,000 a malunga a tujita hanga aliase ni 135,000 a maswalale akwa kole.

Alioze, panjika! Yehova yamba nawa ngwenyi: ‘Nihindu atu oka naye.’ Kashika iye yatuma Ngideone hanga eseke malunga jacho ha kunwa meya mu ka-lwiji aka, malunga eswe waze anachikula mitwe yo ha kunwa meya yaahilwisa ku zuwo. Yehova yalakenya ngwenyi: ‘Yami mungukwaha kukumba ni 300 a malunga waze atalatala ha kunwa meya.’ Mashimbu akuliasa jita yaheta. Ngideone yateta 300 a malunga jenyi mu yizavu yitatu. Iye yahana kuli malunga eswe yitavwi ni masoka mu chima lia milondo. Muze haheta ha muchima ufuku, ayo yajingilika chilombo cha akwa kole jo. Hazehene, ayo eswe hamuwika yemba yitavwi yo nawa yapopola milondo yo, ni kukololoka ngwo: ‘Katana wa Yehova ni wa Ngideone!’ Akwa kole jo muze halaula hi yaputuka kwivwa woma unji. Ayo eswe yaputuka kuchina, mba A-Izalele yakumba jita.Akwa Kuyula kapitulu 6 ndo 8. Yihula ya Longeso

YENA hiunalinga kama chimwe chilakenyo, nawa yichikukaliwa ha kuchifweta? Che chinakapwa kuli lunga au uli ha chizulie, kashika iye ananyenganyana. Lunga wacho mukwa kuyula wa hamu mu Izalele, jina lienyi Jefeta.

Jefeta te katwama ha mashimbu waze A-Izalele te keshi kuwayila nawa Yehova. Ayo te hafunyina kulinga nawa yuma yipi. Kashika Yehova yecha A-Amone hanga aamwese lamba. Mba A-Izalele yatambika Yehova ngwo: ‘Yetwe hitwavulumuna nawa kuli yena. Tunaliumbu, tulamwine kama!’

Atu yalinyenga ha yuma yipi yize ayo anakalinga. Ayo yasolola ngwo halikonekena ha kuputuka kuwayila Yehova cheka. Mba Yehova yaakwasa nawa.

Atu yasakula Jefeta hanga ase jita ni atu api A-Amone. Jefeta te kanazange chinji hanga Yehova amukwase ha kwasa jita yacho. Kashika iye yalakenya kuli Yehova ngwenyi: ‘Nyi mukunjika A-Amone hanga ngwakumbe, mungukakwaha mutu mutangu yoze makatuhuka ku zuwo liami ni kungupatwiza, muze munguhiluka ha kukumba.’ Yehova yevwa chilakenyo cha Jefeta, nawa yamukwasa kukumba. Muze Jefeta te anahiluka ku zuwo, yena unanyingika mutu mutangu yoze te uneza ni kumupatwiza? Mwanenyi wa pwo, wa wika. Jefeta yateta ngwenyi: ‘Lwangu mwanami! Hiwangunehena yinyengo. Mumu yami hinalakenya Yehova, nawa Yami chichi kuhasa kulishingulula ku chilakenyo chami.’

Muze mwana wa Jefeta hanyingika chilakenyo chacho, chitangu ni neye yanyenganyana. Mumu chino te chinalumbunuka ngwo iye mahichika tato ni masepa jenyi. Alioze iye yatayiza kupalikisa mwono wenyi weswe ni kulingila Yehova mu tabernakulu ku Shilo. Mba iye yamba kuli tato ngwenyi: ‘Nyi yena hiwalakenya Yehova, ndo ulinge yize walakenyanga.’

Hohene mwana wa Jefeta yaya ku Shilo, yapalikisa mwono wenyi weswe ni kulingila Yehova mu tabernakulu yenyi. Ha miaka yeswe amwe mapwo a Izalele te kakuchiza matangwa awana hanga aye ni kumumeneka, ayo te kakuwahilila chinji hakupwa hamuwika ha mashimbu jacho. Atu te kakuzanga chinji mwana wa Jefeta, mumu iye te kavumbi mupema wa Yehova.Akwa Kuyula 10:6-18; 11:1-40. Yihula ya Longeso

YENA unanyingika jina lia lunga mukwa tachi jinji te watwama hano hashi? Iye te mukwa kuyula, jina lienyi Samasone. Yehova mwe wahanyine tachi jacho kuli Samasone. Muze te Samasone kanda achisemuka, Yehova yamba kuli naye ngwenyi: ‘Yena mukasema umwe mwana. Iye makasongwela A-Izalele hanga akaalamwine ku moko ja A-Filistea.’

A-Filistea te atu api, ayo te katwama mu Kanana. Ayo te kakwete tujita anji, nawa te kakupinjisa chinji A-Izalele. Limwe tangwa, Samasone te kanayi kuze kwatwama A-Filistea, yalitakana ni umwe ndumba munene. Alioze Samasone yashaha ndumba wacho ni moko. Iye yashaha nawa kama ja A-Filistea api.

Kulutwe lia matangwa, Samasone yazanga umwe pwo jina lienyi te Ndelila. Miata ja A-Filistea yalakenya kuli Ndelila ngwo yetwe eswe mutukakwaha 1,100 wa mbongo ja prata nyi watulweza yize yakuhana tachi jinji kuli Samasone. Ndelila yazanga mbongo jacho jeswe. Iye te hi sepa wamwenemwene ko wa Samasone chipwe wa atu ja Zambi, ka. Kashika iye yaputuka kuhula kuli Samasone matangwa eswe ngwo, yika te yakumwaha tachi.



Hohene, Samasone yalweza kuli Ndelila chijimbikilo cha tachi jenyi. Iye yamba ngwenyi, ‘Kambu jami kanda achijiteta. Chize muze nasemukine, Zambi yangusakula hanga ngupwe umwe kavumbi kenyi mupema yoze anavuluka ngwo Kanazireu. Nyi kambu jami ajiteta, Yami chichi kupwa nawa ni tachi.’

Muze Ndelila hachinyingika yapombesa Samasone mu kondo yenyi, hi iye yaya mu tulo. Iye yasanyika umwe lunga hanga eze atete kambu jenyi. Muze Samasone hahinduka, te tachi keshi najo nawa. Mba A-Filistea yeza yamukwata. Ayo yatuwa meso jenyi, nawa yamutenga kapinji ko.



Limwe tangwa A-Filistea yalikungulula hanga alinge chimwe chiwanyino chinene cha kuwayila zambi yo Ndagone, yaya nikusaka Samasone mu zuwo lia ususu hanga amuhehese. Kumana te kambu ja Samasone hijasoka nawa cheka. Samasone yamba kuli kanuke yoze te unamusongwela ngwenyi: ‘Ngutwale ku manguji waze anakolesa zuwo.’ Hazehene, Samasone yalemba kuli Yehova hanga amwehe tachi, hi yakwata ku manguji aali. Iye yakololoka ngwenyi: ‘Ngweche ngufwe hamwe ni A-Filistea.’ Ha chiwanyino chacho te hali 3,000 a A-Filistea, mba muze Samasone hapuzula manguji, zuwo yilipuzuka, nawa yilishaha atu api eswe waze anakapwamo.Akwa Kuyula kapitulu 13 ndo 16. Yihula ya Longeso

KANUKE au mupema nyi? Jina lienyi Samuele. Lunga au unakwata ha mutwe wa Samuele jina lienyi Eli, sasendote wa lutwe wa Izalele. Tato ya Samuele Elekana ni naye Hana kananeha Samuele kuli Eli.

Samuele te uchili wika ni miaka yiwana hanji yitano. Alioze iye te matwama ku tabernakulu ya Yehova, hamuwika ni Eli ni asasendote akwo. Mumu liaka Elekana ni Hana anahana mwana mukehe chize Samuele hanga alingile Yehova mu Tabernakulu? Tutalenu.

Ku miaka ya kunyima, Hana te kakunyenganyana chinji. Mumu te keshi kusema, alioze iye te kakuzanga chinji kupwa ni umwe mwana. Limwe tangwa Hana yaya ku tabernakulu ya Yehova, iye yalemba ngwenyi: ‘Yehova, kanda unguvulama kama! Nyi yena wangwaha umwe mwana, Yami ngunakulakenya ngwami mungukakwahayo hanga akulingile ha miaka yeswe ya mwono wenyi.’

Yehova yakumbulula kulemba cha Hana, hi kulutwe lia tukweji iye yashita Samuele. Hana te kakuzanga chinji mwanenyi, nawa iye yaputuka kumulongesa shimbi ja Yehova muze te uchili kanuke. Iye yalweza mukwo-lunga ngwenyi: ‘Muze Samuele makola nawa masumuka, yami mungumutwala ku tebernakulu hanga alingile Yehova kuzekwene.’

Yenayi tunamono ha chizulie chino Elekana ni Hana analingi. Nawa Samuele te kakumufumba kanawa kuli yesemi jenyi, iye te kakuwahilila chinji kulingila Yehova muzemwene mu mbalaka ya Yehova. Miaka yeswe Hana ni Elekana te kakuyaya ni kuwayila mu mbalaka yacho yipema, nawa ni kumeneka mwano. Nawa miaka yeswe Hana te kakunuka chimwe chikuto chaha chize kuchishi moko hanga achitwale kuli Samuele.

Samuele kanakalingila Yehova mu tabernakulu ha miaka yinji, iye te kakumuzanga chinji kuli Yehova ni kuli atu. Alioze ana ja sasendote wa lutwe Eli, Hofni ni Finehase te api. Ayo te kakulinga yuma yipi, nawa te kakupiangula akwo hanga ashililike kuli Yehova. Eli kachi te kanakaachiza mu usasendote, alioze iye yeecha.

Mukweze Samuele kakechele ngwo yuma yipi yize te akulinga mu tabernakulu kuli akwo yimukwike kulingila Yehova. Alioze atu akehe te akwete zango lia umwenemwene kuli Yehova, kashika te hikwapalika miaka yinji chize muze Yehova ahanjikile ni umwe mutu. Muze te Samuele hakola ndambu, yikupwa chimwe chuma:

Samuele te kanapombo mu tabernakulu, limwe liji yilimusanyika. Iye yakumbulula ngwenyi: ‘Yami uno.’ Yahinduka yaya kuli Eli yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yami uno, yena wangusanyika, kashika Yami neza.’

Alioze Eli yamukumbulula ngwenyi: ‘Yami chakusanyikine; yako upombe.’ Samuele yafuna ni kupomba.

Liji liacho yiliza nawa kamuchaali yilimusanyika ngwo: ‘Samuele!’ Hohene Samuele yahinduka yaya nawa kuli Eli. Iye yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yami uno, yena wangusanyika, kashika yami neza.’ Alioze Eli yamukumbulula ngwenyi: ‘Yami chakusanyikine, mwanami. Yako kwe upombe. Mba Samuele yafuna ha muhela.

Liji yilimusanyika nawa kamuchitatu ngwo: ‘Samuele!’ Hohene Samuele yaya kuli Eli. Iye yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yami uno, yena mwe wangusanyika nawa.’ Hazehene Eli yanyingika ngwo, kota Yehova unamusanyieka. Kashika Eli yamba kuli Samuele ngwenyi: ‘Yako upombe, nyi makusanyika nawa, yena ndo utayize ngwo: “Amba Yehova, mumu kavumbi ke kanapanjika.”’

Che Samuele anakakumbulula muze Yehova anakamusanyika nawa. Yehova yalweza Samuele ngwenyi, lamba munguneha kuli Eli ni kuli ana jenyi. Kulutwe lia matangwa, Hofni ni Finehase yafwila mu jita yize te anase ni A-Filistea, muze achilwezele kuli Eli, hohene iye yalimbuka, yamakuka kota ni neye yafwa. Ha yino yuma, liji lia Yehova yilipwa lia umwenemwene.

Samuele yakola yapwa mukwa kuyula wa kasula mu Izalele. Muze iye te hapwa kashinakaji, atu yamwita ngwo: ‘Sakula umwe mwata hanga ayule hali yetwe.’ Samuele kakazangile kuchilinga, mumu Yehova te mwe mwata wo. Alioze Yehova yamwamba ngwenyi, panjika atu.1 Samuele 1:1-28; 2:11-36; 4:16-18; 8:4-9. Yihula ya Longeso
